environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed behind Kong API Gateway (OSS 3.4) with a custom request-validator plugin instance configured on the /users route group. The plugin enforces an OpenAPI 3.0 schema where the 'email' query parameter has both a maxLength of 64 characters AND a pattern constraint of '^[^\\s@]{1,40}@[^\\s@]{1,40}$' applied at the gateway layer before proxying. Additionally, the Kong proxy has a request-termination trigger on any query parameter value containing more than 3 consecutive identical non-alphanumeric characters (configured via a custom pre-function plugin using ngx.re.match with 'jo' flags). The upstream NestJS service is only reachable via Kong's internal service mesh network.

access: if ngx.re.match(ngx.var.args or '', '([^a-zA-Z0-9])\\1{3,}', 'jo') then return kong.response.exit(400, {message='invalid parameter format'}) end

config.network: upstream only accessible via Kong service mesh (no direct ingress)
